summary: The three-large-eigenvalue hypothesis does not force a single original-coordinate cut and six-row complement-Hellinger third-volume packet of universal size. For A_k=[[0,M_k],[M_k^T,0]], M_k=U_k V_3^T with U_k consisting of k copies of each e_j/sqrt(k) and dense orthogonal V_3=I-(2/3)11^T, spec(A_k) contains +1 and -1 each three times and every physical cross coefficient is nonzero, but the supremum over every original-coordinate cut and every six-row packet of the complement-Hellinger currency is at most 8/k^3. For mixed cuts, a right-bank coloop set prevents two disjoint row bases; for the natural cut the exact maximum is 8/k^3. This refutes only the local-extraction implication, not QFORM. Global compatibility-Hellinger aggregation on all disjoint bases has exact effective currency 1 and gives ||p_Q||inf<=3e uniformly in k.
